intake: Five manifests describe 161 uniquely owned root references, 15 complete rooms and 15 entrance contracts. Root indices are authoritative for this snapshot; duplicate or empty names are normal.

Run recovery/full/north-check.py against the read-only completed town.glb. It verifies the complete source hash, roots, ownership, hidden/skinned room contents and genuine door markers; evidence goes under proof/full.

After the complete native intake, run recovery/full/north-prepare-editors.py. It creates additive previews/descriptors and separate Objects seeds. It refuses existing scene files to preserve native edits.

City, quay/pier, tide/water, generic dressing, crowd and transport resources are shared once at runtime. Editor preview scenes may reference them for context. Preview bounds never clip geometry or reparent runtime children.

lock5713 includes a hidden sloop at x250 and another sailboat near the dock; its bounds are much wider than the lock mechanics. opening_bridges5768 includes travelling boats. Preserve complete assemblies and original pivots.
mills3628 contains both harbour led dray3629 and outer mill assets. Keep the full shared hierarchy; inspect the harbour child independently.

Steen1967 has opening_st_0001968 and ROOM_steen9343, at a 2.2 m courtyard floor. Oostershuis2890 has 321 opening markers; the public dock gate is opening_oh_3003191 and ROOM_oostershuis9250. Hidden lamp/shutter/punch meshes remain part of their rooms.
Full native intake removes source camera rig1611. Native root paths were checked against roots.json; it is omitted from the Rijnkaai preview and no missing root resource remains.
editing: Open world/districts/<id>.tscn in Godot for the regional source scene. Shared geometry is referenced from world/town/roots/node-NNNNN.scn; edit those shared native assets deliberately because all previews use them.

Open the workshop with --district <id>, choose Street lamp, place it, turn with R and save with Ctrl+S. The new native districts reuse the reviewed placeable library. Their layouts live at user://layouts/<id>/layout.json.

For direct Godot editing, open <id>.objects.tscn, add or duplicate an AuthoredObject wrapper with a valid library asset, give it a unique ObjectId, move it in world coordinates and save. Keep Objects at an identity transform.

A saved complete layout overrides the Objects seed, including deletions. --scene-seed tests editor seeds. --author-root selects an isolated per-district layout root; the old --author-dir option keeps its exact reviewed Rijnkaai folder meaning in the full game.

NativeDistrictLayouts.Apply attaches Objects only and never saves. Save is an explicit authoring operation through the atomic LayoutStore. Bare ids persist in layouts; runtime identities are district/id.

Never rewrite the canonical rijnkaai-recovered scene, its permanent ids, or Steve's live 15-object layout during intake, preview generation or proof runs. Full intake removes the six original lamp copies and eight merged bollards before the reviewed authored overlay is attached.

Full play uses game/town.tscn with native services. A district preview/workshop is for placement and does not itself include menus, crowd, weather and gameplay. Use the native game launcher for the user test.
review: 383 source-contract checks pass, plus207 isolated rule checks and17445 original comparisons. Root performed full rendered weather/worker playtests; this inventory alone cannot certify every district spawn, edge, material or movable collision.

Follow AGENTS.md material edge rule. Review coping and underside at both quay sides, stone/wood joins, exposed cast flanges, bridge/lock wood noses and harbour hut corners in dry day, rain, darkness and reflection views.

Intentional hinge/mating surfaces, thin glazing/sheet rims, rails and cutting/machined surfaces retain their construction appropriate edge. Exposed masonry, timber and cast surfaces are not exempt; record a specific exception rather than assuming every source edge is acceptable.

Run recovery/full/north-layout-proof.tscn with --layout-proof <isolated folder> and a copied --author-dir or --author-root. It verifies read-only complete layout precedence, qualified ids, repeated-apply rejection, atomic backups, duplicate-id rejection and corrupt-save preservation.
